com.vector.cfg.util.text.log

Interface IUserInteractionMessageService

  • All Known Subinterfaces:
    IUserInteractionApi

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
 @ThreadSafe
public interface IUserInteractionMessageService

    The IUserInteractionMessageService provides an API to communicate directly with the user in multiple application scenarios like GUI, command line, AI. The following modes of interaction are supported:

    Reporting Messages

    Use case: the application wants to inform the user about something but is not interested in getting an answer from the user.

    See report(IMessage) and linked javadoc on messages which do not require the users immediate attention.

    Most reporting methods accept Objects as messages. These are translated into human readable texts in the following order:

    • IMessage (no support for Arrays, Iterables or Iterators of IMessage)
    • IQuestion (no support for Arrays, Iterables or Iterators of IQuestion)
    • IDialog (no support for Arrays, Iterables or Iterators of IDialog)
    • IDetailedUserMessage
    • IUserMessage
    • IMixedText
    • Throwable
    • IStatus
    • IFormattable
    • Iterable
    • Iterator
    • Array
    • Ask the FormattingService, if there is a custom formatter for the type.
    • String
    • Object

    Asking Simple Questions

    Use case: the application requires the user to make a decision on how to proceed. The application asks the user a question to which there is a fix set of answers. See ask(IQuestion) and linked javadoc on asking questions.

    See okCancel(Boolean, Consumer), yesNo(Boolean, Consumer) and answerFromUser(Consumer, String, String...) convenience APIs for implementing the most basic questions.

    Engaging the User in a Dialog

    Use case: the application requires complex feedback from the user. E.g. the user has to provide the parameterization of a complex operation. See query(IDialog) and linked javadoc on dialogs.

    This is an ApplicationService.

    This ApplicationService is threadsafe.

    • Method Detail

      • answerFromUser

        @KeepSecretFromPublishedApi
 @Nullable
java.lang.String answerFromUser(java.util.function.Consumer<? super com.vector.cfg.util.text.log.IMsg<?>> question,
                                                                         @Nullable
                                                                         java.lang.String defaultAnswer,
                                                                         java.lang.String... answers)
        This method blocks for an answer from the user.
        Parameters:
        question - specify your question here
        defaultAnswer - if non-null this is added as default answer (see IQuestionApi.defaultAnswer(String, Runnable)) to your question
        answers - these answers are added as normal answers (choices for the user) to your question
        Returns:
        the answer selected by the user. When there is a GUI the user may choose to close the dialog without selecting an answer. In this case null is returned.
